[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Gabriel Fontes, Client Accounting Lead (mid).
Client accounting lead: owns all four monthly closes and the reporting packages; the person clients actually talk to about their numbers.
Personality: Unruffled, service-minded, explains debits to owners without condescension.
Email register: Client-warm, plain English; signs 'Gabriel Fontes'.
Chat register: Efficient, matter-of-fact.
Working hours: 08:00-17:00

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Gabriel Fontes, Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Quarterly tip reporting—looks off

Hey Gabriel, Sylvia,

Quick one—I’m looking at the tip numbers for this quarter and something feels off. The totals don’t line up with what I’m seeing from the floor, and I want to make sure we’re not running into an issue before we file.

Can you two pull the per-location breakdown and compare it to the sales reports we’ve got? I need to know if it’s a data entry thing or if we’ve got a real discrepancy. Let’s get this squared away by end of week if we can.

Appreciate you both jumping on this.

Marco

---

From: Sylvia Nakamura
To: Marco Petrosyan
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting—looks off

Hi Marco,

Thanks for flagging this. I’m on it. I’ll pull the per-location tip totals and compare them side-by-side with the sales reports we have on file. I’ll also double-check the allocation methodology to rule out a system rounding or entry issue before we consider it a real discrepancy.

I’ll have a summary for you and Gabriel by end of day Wednesday, so we have time to address anything before Friday. If I find a genuine mismatch, I’ll include the specific locations and the delta per site, plus what I recommend for correction.

Gabriel, happy to coordinate if you want to review the sales-side numbers against mine before we send anything back to Marco.

Best,
Sylvia

---

From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Sylvia Nakamura, Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting—looks off

Sylvia, thanks for jumping on this so fast. That works—end of day Wednesday is perfect. Gabriel, can you sync with Sylvia on the sales-side numbers and make sure we’re all looking at the same data? If you find anything, just flag it in the summary so we can fix it before Friday. Appreciate you both. Marco

---

From: Sylvia Nakamura
To: Marco Petrosyan, Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting—looks off

Hi Marco,

Just a quick update—I’ve completed the per-location tip total comparison against the sales reports we have on file. The numbers are aligned at the aggregate level, but I did find two locations where the tip allocation rounds slightly differently than the sales-side totals: Harborview and Millbrook. The deltas are under $50 per site, and they stem from how the system applies the tip pool percentage to fractional sales figures.

I’ve confirmed this is a rounding artifact in the allocation formula, not a data entry issue or a missing report. No correction is needed before filing, but I’ll note this in the quarterly reconciliation so we can adjust the formula threshold going forward if you want.

Gabriel, I’m sending you the side-by-side breakdown separately for a quick look—happy to walk through it if anything jumps out.

I’ll file the quarterly report as scheduled on Friday. Let me know if you want any changes before then.

Best,
Sylvia
